sentences.text: Colin Edward Quinn -LRB- born June 6 , 1959 -RRB- is an American stand-up comedian , actor , and writer .	American	United States

On television , he is best known for his work on Saturday Night Live , where he anchored Weekend Update , on MTV 's 1980s game show Remote Control , where he served as the announcer/sidekick , and as host of Comedy Central 's late-night panel show Tough Crowd with Colin Quinn .	Remote Control	Remote Control (game show)	Weekend Update	Weekend Update	Saturday Night Live	Saturday Night Live	Tough Crowd with Colin Quinn	Tough Crowd with Colin Quinn	MTV	MTV	Comedy Central	Comedy Central

Notable film work includes his role as Dooey in A Night at the Roxbury , Dickey Bailey in the Grown Ups films and playing Amy Schumer 's father in the film Trainwreck .	A Night at the Roxbury	A Night at the Roxbury	Grown Ups	Grown Ups (film)	Amy Schumer	Amy Schumer	Trainwreck	Trainwreck (film)
Comedians such as Jerry Seinfeld and Dave Attell cite him as the quintessential New York comedian .	New York	New York (state)	Jerry Seinfeld	Jerry Seinfeld	Dave Attell	Dave Attell
Quinn has also become known for his comedic one-man shows that offer his unique takes on history and growing up in New York City .	New York	New York (state)	New York City	New York City

As of 2015 , he has written and starred in five shows : Irish Wake , My Two Cents , Long Story Short , Unconstitutional , and The New York Story , two of which he collaborated on with Seinfeld as director .	New York	New York (state)

Long Story Short was filmed as an HBO special that aired on April 9 , 2011 and Unconstitutional and The New York Story were released as Netflix specials .	New York	New York (state)	HBO	HBO	Netflix	Netflix
